summary: Healthy Extracts Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of 100% of Adli Gummies Inc. (dba Imara's Beauty) via subsidiary Healthy Extracts Canada Inc. Consideration includes secured promissory notes totaling $794,000 ($165K to largest shareholder Aaron Hefter; $629K to other holders), 2,159,520 HE Canada Class B shares (exchangeable 1:1 for common stock) issued to Hefter, and 840,480 shares of common stock to other shareholders. The CEO canceled 3,000,000 shares; total issued shares represent ~17.76% of outstanding. Hefter entered a Consulting Agreement as Chief Brand Officer. Watch future dilution from exchangeable shares and regulatory filings.
